TabDefinition.description: What a tab is beyond its name (Sprint 18, ADR-0128). The only kind today is CUSTOM: the tab shows a custom page. An object needs no tab of its own: the navigation item OBJECT opens it.

VisibilityInner.description: A condition, or a group of conditions combined with all (AND) or any (OR).

VisibilityLeaf.description: One condition: a field compared with a value, or the person holding an ability.

VisibilityRule.description: When a component or an action is shown. Closed data, never text that is evaluated: a condition, or all/any of conditions, nested once. The expression engine of Sprint 13 may add to this list, never replace it.
